results.title: Border Guards seize 80.6 kg of khat, 31,500 tablets in Asir, Jazan operations
results.description: Border Guard patrols arrested two border security violators in separate anti-drug operations in Asir and Jazan, while also thwarting a smuggling attempt in Jazan, seizing 80 kilograms and 600 grams of khat and 31,500 tablets. In Asir, Border Guard land patrols in the Al-Rabwah Sector arrested a citizen for attempting to smuggle 600 grams of khat. Meanwhile, in Jazan, Border Guard land patrols in the Al-Dair Sector arrested an Ethiopian border security violator for attempting to smuggle 80 kilograms of khat. In a separate operation in Jazan, Border Guard land patrols in the Al-Dair Sector thwarted an attempt to smuggle 31,500 tablets subject to medical circulation regulations. In the Asir and Jazan arrest cases, authorities said initial legal procedures were completed against the suspects, who were handed over along with the seized contraband to the competent authority. For the separate Jazan case, initial legal procedures were completed and the seized contraband was handed over to the competent authority. results.title: Saudi Arabia registers 9,586 new urban heritage assets, bringing total to 59,586
results.description: The Heritage Commission has added 9,586 architectural heritage assets to the National Register of Urban Heritage across various regions of Saudi Arabia, bringing the total number of registered assets to 59,586. Asir recorded the largest number of newly registered assets at 4,363, bringing its total to 25,110. Al-Baha followed with 2,547 new registrations, raising its total to 7,820, while Makkah recorded 1,755 new assets, bringing the total there to 7,786. Najran added 673 assets, bringing its total to 1,610, while Riyadh recorded 169 new registrations for a total of 6,072. Madinah added 23 assets, bringing its total to 4,003, while Hail recorded 21 new assets for a total of 2,403. The Eastern Province added 19 assets, raising its total to 1,154, while Qassim recorded 13 new assets for a total of 2,364. Tabuk added two assets, bringing its total to 198, while the Northern Borders Region recorded one new asset, raising its total to 111. The commission also registered a total of 457 architectural heritage assets in Al-Jouf and a total of 498 in Jazan.

results.title: Thunderstorms forecast across parts of Kingdom as temperatures reach 47°C
results.description: Thunderstorms accompanied by rain are expected over parts of the Kingdom on Tuesday, while temperatures are forecast to reach up to 47°C in some areas, according to the National Center for Meteorology (NCM). For the heatwave, Riyadh is forecast to reach a high of 46°C, while temperatures are expected to climb to 44°C in Makkah, 45°C in Madinah, and 42°C in Jeddah. Dammam is expected to experience the highest temperature at 47°C. Elsewhere, highs of 32°C are expected in Abha, 39°C in Tabuk, 47°C in Buraidah, 42°C in Hail and Najran, 31°C in Al-Baha, 45°C in Arar, 43°C in Sakaka, and 38°C in Jazan. Hot to extremely hot weather is also expected to continue over parts of the Northern Borders Region. As for the NCM’s rain forecast, thunderclouds accompanied by rain are expected over parts of Jazan, Asir, Najran, Riyadh, and the Eastern Province. Active winds stirring up dust and sand are expected over parts of those regions, as well as parts of Madinah and Makkah, with horizontal visibility potentially dropping to near zero along the coastal road leading to Jazan.
